comparison.objective: Install one rack rail; record sorts six bottles between crowded shelf levels.
comparison.physical_skill: Mechanical latching, telescoping alignment, and tool fastening versus repeated grasp/place actions, staged rearrangement, and collision/stability management around neighboring objects.
comparison.success_condition: Self-supporting rail at the correct rack unit with full prong and screw engagement versus all bottles on matching shelves, upright and stable for 2 s, with no fall/tilt/workspace violation.
comparison.reason: Crowded multi-object sorting does not test staged mechanical attachment; shared bimanual collision avoidance is only generic.
